about: A150 (Barentin - Écalles-Alix): ALBEA publishes its 2026 prices only as an image. Transcribed by hand from it; tools/tables fetches the image again and says if it has changed (sha256). Prices in EUR including 20% VAT from the Bouville barrier to the exits on SAPN's A29 beyond it, by EURO class: class 3 (two axles) and class 4 (more). The image's columns: outside the scheme (hors périmètre), EURO 0-3, 4, 5, 6, 7.
